The '''Skirmish near Brigia''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack during the the transfer of wounded following the [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|evacuation of Brigia]].

==The battle==
Following the [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|evacuation of Brigia]], several [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], along with the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Korolev]]'' were transferring wounded personnel to the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Nebulon-B frigate [[Warspite (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Warspite'']] dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and launched [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] fighters. It then jumped to hyperspace again, emerging on the other side of the transfer and launching more fighters.

[[File:Korolev.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''[[Korolev]]'' is attacked by a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]].]]

The defending Rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] had moved to intercept the first wave and were out of position for the second wave. The pilots of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], particularly [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], were able to evade the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] long enough to destroy both waves of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] and all Rebel ships escaped successfully. Key to their success was Farlander's decision to use his [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] to destroy the first wave of TIE Bombers quickly, along with ignoring the threat of the TIE Fighters, which were attacking the X-wings themselves, until all TIE Bombers had been destroyed.

==Legacy==
A [[Redemption scenario|simulation]] based on this battle would later be part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] training program. When [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] reformed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], this test was used as one of the benchmarks for candidates to enter the squadron.
